clubs.tacticsWhy: FotMob, 8 league games: possession 63.4% (1st of 18), 493 accurate passes per match (1st), 4.3 possession wins in the final third per match (5th), 62 corners (1st). My own figures from FotMob per-match data: attempted long balls are 7.7% of all passes (lowest in the league, average 12.3%) -> passing 2. 59.0% of accurate passes are in the opposition half (1st, average 44.3%) -> line 4, style 'off'. 17.0 attempted crosses per match (7th, average 15.9) -> width 3. Opponent passes per Benfica tackle+interception+foul is 9.2 (lowest in the league, average 11.5; a whole-pitch PPDA proxy that is inflated by possession) and opponents complete only 78.5% of passes (3rd lowest) -> press 4. Tempo 3: patient possession, but no tempo metric found. setAtt/setDef are placeholders: no source on routines or marking.

clubs.tacticsWhy: FotMob, 8 league games: possession 54.8% (4th of 18) but only 364 accurate passes per match (8th, league average 355), so Porto move the ball forward faster than Benfica (493) and Sporting (490) -> tempo 4. 4.9 possession wins in the final third per match (3rd); opponents complete 78.5% of passes (4th lowest); opponent passes per Porto tackle+interception+foul 10.1 (3rd lowest; my whole-pitch PPDA proxy) -> press 4. My figures from FotMob match data: 22.3 attempted crosses per match (2nd, average 15.9) -> width 4. Attempted long balls are 9.2% of passes (13th, average 12.3%) -> passing 2. 47.4% of accurate passes in the opposition half (5th) and only 0.4 opponent offsides per match (17th) -> line 3. Best defensive record: 0.5 goals conceded per match, 0 set-piece goals conceded; 4 set-piece goals scored (2nd) -> style 'normal'. No source on corner routines or marking scheme, so setAtt/setDef are placeholders.
clubs.desc: FC Porto spiller en kompakt 4-3-3, der presser aggressivt, angriber hurtigt ud ad kanterne med mange indlæg og er farlig på dødbolde.
uncertain: This XI had three changes from the Benfica game: Moura, Varela and Hwang came in for Martim Fernandes, Rosario and Gabri Veiga. The most frequent league starters are Rosario (#13, 6 starts) at DM and Gabri Veiga (#10, 7 starts) at LCM. At LB: Sanusi (#12, 4 starts, injured day-to-day), Moura (3 starts) and Martim Fernandes (2 starts). I kept the latest XI because the changes were the coach's choice; nobody was rotated for a European game.

Midfield sides (Froholdt RCM, Varela DM, Hwang LCM) come from FotMob's layout; ESPN did not label Varela or Hwang. One Maisfutebol summary said Moura came in at right-back, but ESPN and FotMob both have him at left-back.

Away kit colour is disputed: New Balance and footballfashion.org say deep purple with cream; the club, Footy Headlines and retailers say ruby/claret. #4E1D3D is a compromise. Home hex is FotMob's team colour; footballfashion.org confirms blue and white stripes.
